meta.title: Video Lab — Dựng, ghép và chuẩn hoá video hàng loạt trên Windows
meta.description: Video Lab gom Studio dựng cảnh có giọng đọc, Mixer ghép Intro–Main–Outro hàng loạt và Encode chuẩn hoá cho mọi nền tảng vào một ứng dụng Windows, tăng tốc bằng GPU.
meta.ogTitle: Video Lab — một cửa sổ cho cả dây chuyền video
meta.ogDescription: Dựng cảnh, ghép hàng loạt, chuẩn hoá — chạy ngay trên máy bạn.

hero.lead: Dựng cảnh từ ảnh và kịch bản, ghép Intro – Main – Outro hàng loạt, chuẩn hoá cho mọi nền tảng. Tất cả chạy ngay trên máy bạn, tăng tốc bằng GPU.

meta.title: Video Lab — Build, batch-join and normalise videos on Windows
meta.description: Video Lab puts a narrated scene Studio, a batch Intro–Main–Outro Mixer and an upload-ready Encode into one Windows app, accelerated by your GPU.
meta.ogTitle: Video Lab — one window for the whole video pipeline
meta.ogDescription: Build scenes, batch-join, normalise — right on your own machine.

hero.title: One window for the whole
hero.lead: Build scenes from images and a script, batch-join Intro – Main – Outro, and normalise for every platform. All of it runs on your own machine, accelerated by your GPU.

pipelineHead.title: Three screens.
pipelineHead.lead: Each screen does one job well and hands its result to the next with a single click.

pipelineNodes.body: Images + script + voice → scenes laid out on a keyframe timeline.
Join Intro, Main and Outro in order or at random, producing a batch of videos at once.
Bring every clip to one upload profile so joined videos never freeze.

featuresHead.title: Fast,
featuresHead.lead: What Video Lab takes care of, so all you do is press Start.

guideHead.title: From install to
guideHead.lead: Scroll to walk through each screen — every screenshot comes from the app itself.

videoHead.title: Watch once,
videoHead.lead: Narrated in Vietnamese with chapters — click the timeline to jump to the part you need.

cta.title: Ready to build your first video?
cta.body: Windows 64-bit installer with FFmpeg included. The app updates itself when a new version ships.

guidePage.title: Video Lab guide — step by step, with real screenshots
guidePage.description: Step-by-step Video Lab guide: install, build scenes in Studio, batch-join in Mixer, normalise with Encode.
guidePage.lead: Five short chapters, one per screen. Read them in order or jump straight to what you need.
guidePage.videoTitle: The whole tour in a few minutes

downloadPage.title: Download Video Lab for Windows
downloadPage.description: Get the latest Video Lab installer for Windows 10/11 64-bit. FFmpeg included, updates itself.
downloadPage.note: The file downloads straight from GitHub Releases.

install.title: Run `Video-Lab-Setup-….exe`
install.body: If Windows SmartScreen warns you, click *More info → Run anyway*.

install.title: Follow the installer
install.body: Pick a folder (the default is fine) and click Install. It takes about a minute.

install.title: Open Video Lab
install.body: From the Start Menu or the desktop icon. The first launch may take a few seconds while the worker starts.
